normalized_frobenius|total|optimal|canon.formula: min_P ||u(W_i(t)) - P u(W_j(0))||_2, with u the flattened joint W0/W1 vector after canonical neuron gauge and total L2 normalization
normalized_frobenius|total|optimal|canon.normalization: Equalize incoming/outgoing neuron norms first; divide BOTH W0 and W1 by sqrt(||W0||_F^2+||W1||_F^2)
normalized_frobenius|total|optimal|canon.matching: Maximize the joint normalized W0/W1 inner product with a global Hungarian assignment for one hidden layer
normalized_frobenius|total|optimal|canon.equivalence: Distance squared = 2*(1-cosine), because both full vectors have norm one
normalized_frobenius|total|optimal|canon.orientation: distances[0,t,i,j]: current query run i at checkpoint t versus candidate run j at checkpoint E0
normalized_frobenius|total|optimal|canon.permutation_orientation: p[k] is candidate hidden neuron assigned to query hidden neuron k; aligned candidate=(B0[:,p],B1[p,:])
normalized_frobenius|total|optimal|canon.identity_policy: The matching functions receive no run identity. All 100 entries, including the diagonal, use the same computation; no diagonal replacement or preference
normalized_frobenius|total|optimal|canon.zero_norm_convention: Reuse the deterministic 01_RSA neuron-level convention. Reject an entirely zero full weight vector, for which unit normalization is undefined.
normalized_frobenius|total|optimal|canon.norms_arrays: norms_raw/canonical retain PRE-total-normalization W0,W1,total norms in norm_layers order
